what_works: Limited palette with primary dark, accent purple, and light background creates clear visual hierarchy.
Consistent 8px radius on cards, buttons, and UI elements gives a cohesive, modern look.
Calendar layout uses a clean grid with ample whitespace, improving readability and scanability.
AI assistant overlay employs a semi‑transparent, rounded card that integrates smoothly with the main interface.
Interactive cues such as the play button and chat bubble use subtle shadows to indicate clickability.
